title: Nne a Ɛma Wogyina Pintinn
intro: Wɔkae saa onipa yi wɔ nyansa ne akwankyerɛ a emu dɔ ho, na ɔde afotu a ɛboro awo ntoatoaso so ma. Wɔn nsɛm yɛ onyamesom pa ne hia a ɛho hia sɛ yehu nhyira ne sɔhwɛ ahorow a efi Ɔsoro no mu no ho adanse. Da onii ko a ɔkra a wobu no yi te adi.
clues: Na mennyɛ odiyifo, nanso wɔama me nyansa a enwu da wɔ Ɔsoro Kyerɛwnsɛm no mu.
M’afotuo a mede maa me ba no sii aseda a mede ma Allah ne shirk a mekwati so dua.
Mekyerɛkyerɛɛ hia a mpaebɔ ho hia, papayɛ a wɔhyɛ, ne bɔne a wɔbara.
Mebɔɔ kɔkɔ wɔ ahantan ne ahomaso nantew asase so ho.
Wɔde me din ato Quran no mu ti mũ bi so, a ɛtwe adwene si me nkyerɛkyerɛ so.
Nea ɛka m’afotu ho ne boasetɔ wɔ amanehunu mu, efisɛ nokwarem no, ɛno fi nsɛm a wɔasi wɔn bo sen biara mu.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
